evidence: Swap (fail): a GP-surgery appointment booker or a library meeting-room booker could take the when/vehicle/confirm/done frame unchanged; only the copy (20-minute slots, vehicle, permit DRC-, 'the gate') and the small bin glyph beside 'Dunmore District Council' would change. With the name hidden, the first viewport ('Book a slot', day buttons, time grid) reads as any timed-slot booking.

Category-guess (fail): the predicted default for a UK council booking form is a white masthead with the council name, pale ground, one civic green, bold sans headings, outlined option buttons, a red-bordered 'There is a problem' error summary and a reference shown in a card; every identity-carrying element on these screens matches that default.

Similar-prompt (fail): 'a council booking service for collecting a parking permit / a bulky-waste collection date' would land on the same green-on-pale form, the same slot grid of outlined boxes with availability tags, and the same 'Booked / Your reference' card.

What does belong to the product: the copy voice ('the gate checks the reference and the vehicle', 'Rubble (up to four bags)', 'Show this at the gate, on your phone or on paper') and the availability states on slots. These are content, not an identity layer; there is no signature element.

unfinished: identity is only the council name in bold body text beside a small 1.5px bin glyph in a plain white masthead (all routes)

done page: the reference DR-204117 sits in the same white bordered card as everything else; no focal moment for the thing the resident must carry to the gate, and at 1280 the page ends at ~716px leaving an empty grey band below the footer

half-empty columns at wide widths: at 1280 the Opening days and Your reference cards stretch to 1088px while their text stops at ~610px, and the form columns on vehicle/confirm leave the right half of the page empty
the 'Few left' band on the when page is a block of identical amber pills (7 at 1280 for Today, 10 for Saturday) that reads as repetition rather than information design
sections are mostly a heading and a list of identical boxes (When, Slots, Vehicle, What are you bringing?) with no visual moment on any screen
headings differ from body mainly by size and weight in one face; no typographic moment
evidence: root/default/1280-light.png and root/slot-chosen/1280-dark.png: first viewport is heading, intro, step text, four outlined day buttons, then a grid of white boxes; colour work is limited to the green Next button and amber/grey tags
done-html.../default/1280-light.png and 375-light.png: reference in a plain card, 'Book another slot' outline button, no booking summary or visual weight beyond a 32px heading
vehicle.../van/1280-light.png and confirm.../default/1280-light.png: tidy GOV-style form, clean and orderly, nothing to look at
It is clean, consistent and legible in both themes; it is plain, not unappealing.
